title: Another weekend of giving
html:
Last Monday I wrote about the Finn family and their project to raise money for Oxfam and then, this weekend, we had Telethon. Didn’t that bring back memories? Bet you still know the words to the song.

Telethon raised almost $2million for Kids Can; a great organisation that helps kids have something we all take for granted, breakfast.

Watching it from time to time didn’t give me the feeling it used to though; it felt contrived and I missed Grand Designs.

Did you give money on the weekend or did you feel that the responsibility of raising kids has, yet again, been taken away by someone more passionate than the actual parents?

I feel sure we can do more for these kids by looking over our neighbour’s fence from time to time, having a chat and offering help. Giving your time, love and passion is like teaching someone to fish. They will be able to eat forever, not just buy fish and chips.
